meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of achieve.
meaning.vi: Ngôi thứ ba số ít thì hiện tại đơn dạng biểu thị thành tựu.

sentences.en: The city achieves the feat of being cozy rather than crowded.

sentences.en: Our vision is to ensure government achieves substantive equality for disabled people by 2025.
sentences.vi: Tầm nhìn của chúng tôi là đảm bảo chính phủ đạt được bình đẳng thực chất cho người khuyết tật vào năm 2025.

sentences.en: The University consistently achieves graduate employment rates higher than the national average.

sentences.en: Within this narrow compass, he achieves remarkable diversity of structure and emotional tone.
sentences.vi: Trong chiếc la bàn hẹp này, anh ấy đạt được sự đa dạng đáng kể về cấu trúc và giọng điệu cảm xúc.

sentences.en: They are able to provide dependable, reliable technical assistance to ensure your stencil consistently achieves the best results.

sentences.en: In effect, it achieves its results by temporarily raising or lowering the bond dissociation energy.

sentences.en: At first he stages a recovery and achieves some equanimity but fate is not finished toying with him.

sentences.en: In looking at the change from oral culture to the world of literacy, Ong achieves a beautiful equipoise.

sentences.en: With each passing day human intelligence enlarges the horizons of the possible and achieves prodigious feats.

sentences.en: However, the mechanism by which ECP achieves its effect remains illusive.
